text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike on continuous-batcher path (>5s). Affects streaming and sync-gen routes. SLO alert fired: CI-TAIL-P99. Dashboard: http://grafana.company/alerts/CI-TAIL-P99 :bangbang:

jamie: paging @sanjay, @lee — looks like cont-batcher tail spike, customers seeing streaming stalls. anyone oncall?

sanjay: I'm on, looking at traces. p95 up ~800ms, p99 ~5-8s for the last 10m.

lee: seeing lots of long seq requests getting packed with short ones. batcher waiting for heads for ~200ms on avg then big KV evicts.

maria: customer impact: two enterprise jobs returned retries, CS flagged increased error rate 0.6%. they asked for ETA.

jamie: status check — is this localized to one region/pool?

sanjay: US-WEST cont-batcher pool heavy. Dedicated pools fine. Multi-tenant nodes showing mixed seqlen distribution skew.

kendra: root cause hypothesis: long-seq hogs batcher leading to preempt delay for streaming lanes. KV cache churn also visible — eviction rate up 3x.

lee: quick mitigation: reduce batch_wait_ms from 200 -> 50 for the streaming lanes, and enable seqlen-pin for requests with long prompt. I can push a canary to 3 nodes.

maria: please mention in runbook to escalate to infra if canary fails. CS informed customer that we're investigating and may throttle long jobs.

jamie: go ahead, @lee — run canary and report. Also drop a short message to customers if we throttle.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by lee: deploy/contbatch-config-canary -> canary-3nodes. CI/CD link: http://ci.company/build/7862

lee: canary running. patch: 
```yaml
batcher: 
  modes: streaming:
    batch_wait_ms: 50
    max_batch_size: 32
  seqlen_pin: true
```

lee: initial telemetry: p99 on canary hosts down to ~1.2s after 90s. eviction rate on canary down 60%.

sanjay: nice. rolling to 30% of pool — stepping. Watch for throughput regression.

jamie: watch the mixing fairness metric (queue_fairness_index). If it drops >0.2 we may re-open.

maria: CS asked for ETA to full mitigation. current plan ETA ~15m to 30% roll, 30-60m to full if stable.

lee: rolling to 30%. patch also includes a temporary per-request max_batchers: 
```json
{"per_tenant_max_batchers": 2}
```
to limit tenant-induced packing.

sanjay: seeing p95/p99 trending down cluster-wide now. p99 from 6s -> 1.5s across US-WEST.

kendra: follow-up action items: 1) longer-term: smarter packer that separates long/short seq windows. 2) KV cache size tuning per pool. 3) automated seqlen tagging at routing so batcher can shard.

jamie: agree. file RFC for packer change, and schedule a perf run w/ synthetic mixedseq workload.

maria: customer update: CS sent interim note with mitigation steps and ETA. customer appreciates quick response.

ops-bot: alert suppressed by jamie (manual).

sanjay: monitoring 10m — stable. no error spikes. I'll keep this open for 2h to watch for recurrence.

lee: creating follow-up ticket: INF-5421 "seqmix-aware packer and per-pool kv tuning" with initial perf numbers and proposed schedule.

kendra: adding a post-incident check: run 6h synthetic test at 75/25 short/long seq, record p50/p95/p99 and eviction rates.

jamie: great. closing paging now. if anyone sees recurrence, re-ping this thread. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all. filing customer post-mortem summary for CS.

sanjay: final note: the short-term config decreased unit throughput by ~4% but reduced tail massively. good trade for SLOs.

lee: logs/snippets: 
```
[2026-03-12T18:12:34Z] batch_wait_ms=200 evictions=813 rtt=6200ms
[2026-03-12T18:14:12Z] canary batch_wait_ms=50 evictions=312 rtt=1200ms
```
jamie: thread closed for now — monitoring window started.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: CI-TAIL-P99 in US-WEST — severity lowered.
